disconnected: The tool disconnected before the answer.
not_in_circle: “{model}” is not a model in the AIODOS circle.
where_refused_model: Compute location refused for “{model}”: this application has no access there.
no_allowed_machine: No machine allowed for this application can answer with “{model}” right now.
local_only: This request (images, enforced format, code completion…) can only be computed by this machine, which does not have “{model}”.
tools_elsewhere: “{model}” is only on another machine, which does not accept tools yet.
ollama_down: Ollama is not responding on this machine ({error}).
cloud_refused: Cloud models do not go through the gateway: “{model}”.
not_local_model: “{model}” is not a model on this machine.
embed_here_only: Embeddings are only computed on this machine: “{model}” is not one of its models.
content_not_text: Message content must be a string.
embed_where_denied: Embeddings are only computed on this PC, which this request excludes.
input_invalid: “input” must be a string or a list of strings.
template_unsupported: “template” and “context” (specific to Ollama) are not accepted by the built-in engine: send the whole conversation through /api/chat.
route_unknown: “{route}” is not served by the AIODOS gateway: models are installed and managed in AIODOS (“Install a model”) or with Ollama.
model_unknown: The model “{model}” does not exist in the AIODOS circle.
prompt_single: “prompt” must be a string (one completion at a time).
